description: This file contains unit tests for the DynamoDB storage provider within an Orleans project. It tests the read/write/format conversion operations of the DynamoDB storage component, ensuring correct behavior for persistence, format changes, and conversions.

classes.name: DynamoDBStorageProviderTests
classes.description: A test class for the DynamoDB storage provider, verifying persistence operations, format conversions, and configuration handling.

methods.name: PersistenceProvider_DynamoDB_WriteRead
methods.description: Tests writing and reading a grain state to DynamoDB with optional JSON format.

methods.name: PersistenceProvider_DynamoDB_WriteClearRead
methods.description: Tests writing, clearing, and then reading a grain state from DynamoDB.

methods.name: PersistenceProvider_DynamoDB_ChangeReadFormat
methods.description: Tests reading a grain state with different JSON serialization formats.

methods.name: PersistenceProvider_DynamoDB_ChangeWriteFormat
methods.description: Tests writing a grain state with one format, then re-writing with another, checking format conversion.

methods.name: DynamoDBStorage_ConvertToFromStorageFormat
methods.description: Verifies the conversion between the in-memory grain state and DynamoDB storage format.

methods.name: InitDynamoDBGrainStorage
methods.description: Initializes a DynamoDBGrainStorage instance with specified options.

methods.name: Test_PersistenceProvider_Read
methods.description: Tests reading grain state from storage and verifies correctness.

methods.name: Test_PersistenceProvider_WriteRead
methods.description: Tests writing grain state to storage and then reading it back, verifying data integrity.

methods.name: Test_PersistenceProvider_WriteClearRead
methods.description: Tests writing grain state, clearing it, then reading to ensure state reset.

methods.name: EnsureEnvironmentSupportsState
methods.description: Checks if DynamoDB environment is available; skips tests otherwise.
